decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for a two storey side and rear extension and the replacement of the existing flat roof with a pitched roof to the existing dwellinghouse, because of the position, design and appearance of the  extensions would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of No. 55 Cleveland Gardens and would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original dwellinghouse and the character of the street scene or to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of Council's Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003); Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.
Condition : 5 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 55 Clevedon Gardens
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the southeast elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey side and rear extension and erection of pitched roof to existing single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
